comments.author: Plot_Device
comments.body_html:
After testing across every map, during day and night cycles, and using the following mods listed below, this has been an AWESOME preset where the bots hear me at a fair distance, and are able to engage one another fairly across the map once gunfire starts.

I still recommend turning OFF Faster CQB reactions and “always aim center mass” for SAIN.

MOD stack I use:
SAIN 3.1.0 and Solaraint’s Bullet Crack FIX 1.0, SWAG-DONUTS 3.5.1, REALISM 1.4..4, SPT 3.9.5, That’s Lit 1.394.01, FIKA (server + client), Unicorn 1.1 spawn points for SWAG, and a bunch of QOL mods for GUI/Graphics changes that don’t affect bots. Thank you, Tritantrfl7 this mod rocks!

comments.body_html: why would you turn off faster cqb and always center mass?

comments.author: Plot_Device
comments.body_html:
Faster CQB reactions make the bots react too quickly in close distance and denies the player a chance to fight them in a surprise face-to-face.

Always center mass causes too many stomach blackouts and almost no scatter on recoil spread for limb hits. It’s an old issue with SAIN he is working to fix in the newest test builds. But for now, this is the fix to prevent the issue of bots lasering your chest and stomach at all times.

comments.author: Foertschlive
comments.body_html: Good afternoon! Could you please clarify which setting is responsible for a bot’s quick detection of a player from a distance? I keep encountering situations where a bot immediately detects me from over 50 meters away as soon as I start shooting. Ambushing bots is impossible since they instantly spot the player. It would be understandable if they took some time to figure out where the shots are coming from, but there is absolutely no delay. And often, the bots don’t even have optical sights, just iron sights. This applies to both PMC and Scav bots.

comments.author: Tritantrfl7
comments.body_html:
I’m pretty sure that’s a combination of the effects from both SAIN and That’s Lit. SAIN AI will immediately return fire (it seems unfair in practice, but it should be super inaccurate since they’re being suppressed). What could contribute to them seeing you so quick is the brightness of the environment from That’s Lit. I would tweak reaction times in SAIN and maybe look into the weight of brightness settings in That’s Lit.

I personally notice that with this preset they are quicker to return fire, but it’s mega inaccurate at most ranges. I’ll probably tweak the preset a bit to tone it down.

comments.author: Foertschlive
comments.body_html: Sorry, could you please tell me which settings in SAIN are responsible for this? In That’s Lit, I believe it’s the brightness impact offset.

comments.body_html: Bots retaliate way too fast and accurately when engaged from a distance. Otherwise, detection time, distance and scatter are good.

comments.author: Tritantrfl7
comments.body_html:
That’s largely due to SAIN AI and That’s Lit interacting with each other. If you’re not in a dark, shaded area or heavily concealed by foliage they will automatically start suppressing. Being indoors can help a bit as well. The number one place my own testing has shown where they’ll return fire quickly is when engaging PMC’s in the daylight.

You can increase the parameters of That’s Lit to make you more concealed, I’m probably going to bundle a preset for that as well with the next update

comments.author: Tritantrfl7
comments.body_html: Also if you’re using a suppressed weapon and wondering why they can still engage you at moderate distances, it’s because they have more realistic detection ranges for supersonic rounds
